name: El Centro Zen de Mexico, A.R.
reason: Too thin and probably not current: its own site (sites.google.com/site/czenmx, opened 13 Nov 2026) last lists events from May–June 2020, its weekly-meditation and calendar pages carry no schedule, and there is no current offering, photo or video channel; only a few old teaching texts remain. One web search found no newer site. Owner may revisit (teacher John Tesshin Sanderson, Maezumi lineage; email czenm@yahoo.com on the site).
